```yaml
name: Install Script Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test-install-script:
    name: Test Install Script
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dart pub get

      - name: Format install script
        run: dart format -o none lib/src/workflows/update_project_references.workflow.dart

      - name: Run tests
        run: dart test
```
